# Zion Edge Gateway

> A single auditable Rust binary at the edge of your network: TLS 1.3 termination, a zero-regex WAF (Aho-Corasick), a two-level RAM cache, and an upstream proxy — replacing nginx + a WAF module + a cache + a geo-tagger with one static executable. No sidecars, no control plane, no runtime dependencies. Licensed Apache-2.0.

Zion is configured with explicit TOML knobs (not a black box), ships signed multi-arch containers (cosign + SLSA provenance + CycloneDX SBOM), and hot-reloads config via an atomic pointer swap. Optional feature flags add ACME auto-renewal, JWT/OIDC auth, HTTP/3 (QUIC), JA4 TLS fingerprinting, and an AIMP gossip mesh.

## Documentation

- [What is Zion?](https://fabriziosalmi.github.io/zion/guide/): overview, design goals, and when to reach for it
- [Quick start](https://fabriziosalmi.github.io/zion/guide/quickstart): from zero to a running TLS proxy in ~30 seconds
- [Migrating to Zion](https://fabriziosalmi.github.io/zion/guide/migrate): `zion import` from nginx, Traefik, and Caddy configs
- [CLI reference](https://fabriziosalmi.github.io/zion/guide/cli): every subcommand and flag
- [Architecture](https://fabriziosalmi.github.io/zion/guide/architecture): request lifecycle, module map, and concurrency model

## Configuration

- [Configuration reference](https://fabriziosalmi.github.io/zion/config/): the full TOML schema
- [TLS & SNI](https://fabriziosalmi.github.io/zion/config/tls): certificates, SNI resolution, mTLS, session tickets
- [ACME auto-renewal](https://fabriziosalmi.github.io/zion/config/acme): HTTP-01 issuance via Let's Encrypt
- [Routing](https://fabriziosalmi.github.io/zion/config/routing): radix-tree host/path routing and route modes
- [Caching](https://fabriziosalmi.github.io/zion/config/caching): the two-level (thread-local L1 + shared L2) cache
- [WAF](https://fabriziosalmi.github.io/zion/config/waf): the five-gate, zero-regex WAF pipeline
- [Authentication](https://fabriziosalmi.github.io/zion/config/auth): per-route JWT/OIDC validation

## Security

- [WAF pipeline](https://fabriziosalmi.github.io/zion/security/): how requests are inspected
- [Hardening](https://fabriziosalmi.github.io/zion/security/hardening): production deployment hardening
- [Threat model (STRIDE)](https://fabriziosalmi.github.io/zion/security/threat-model): assets, threats, mitigations
- [Supply chain](https://fabriziosalmi.github.io/zion/security/supply-chain): signing, provenance, and SBOM verification
